text:
Sam (People Ops): drop-in kit for goal-setting + short review snippets managers and ICs can reuse. Trying to keep it very copy/paste friendly.
Aisha (Product Manager): love this. can you give a 2-line calendar blurb?
Sam (People Ops): calendar blurb: 'Quick goal check: 20m to review progress, blockers, and 1 support ask. Bring your 2-line self-summary.'
Riley (SWE): can we get a 2-line self-summary template ICs can paste into the performance form?
Sam (People Ops): 2-line self-summary (paste):
"Role & focus: [one line]. Top outcome(s): [1-2 brief bullets with links/metrics]."
Nora (Design): any short manager guide for calibration discussions?
Sam (People Ops): manager calibration cheat (one-sentence each):
Impact: state outcome + metric or customer quote.
Ownership: note scope led and cross-team coordination.
Development: one growth area and a suggested next step.
Aisha (Product Manager): nice. can we have a single-question peer feedback prompt for async asks?
Sam (People Ops): yes 1 async peer prompt: "What's one concrete thing they did that helped you ship?" (1-2 bullets). Example: "Filed clear acceptance criteria that saved QA time."
Riley (SWE): what's a concise upward feedback ask I can send my manager?
Sam (People Ops): upward ask (one-liner): "Two bullets please: 1) one thing I should stop/start/continue; 2) one thing you can remove as a blocker this sprint."
HR Bot: Reminder: use `/perf reminder add --when midpoint-2w --team @team` to schedule midpoint nudges. See /docs/perf/reminders.
Nora (Design): will paste into our team handbook. thanks!
Sam (People Ops): version v0.9. If you adapt wording for role-specific needs, paste new version tag here so we can track updates.
Aisha (Product Manager): will update for PMs (on-call note).
Sam (People Ops): awesome, thanks everyone :clap:
